name: Sheraton Addis
insider_take: Africa's diplomatic capital meets luxury hospitality in this elevated oasis above the bustling streets of Addis Ababa.
whats_special: The Sheraton Addis sits at 8,000+ feet above sea level, making it one of the world's highest capital city hotels. As Ethiopia's first international luxury hotel, it's been hosting world leaders and dignitaries since 1998, with the African Union headquarters just minutes away. The hotel's unique position offers stunning views of the Entoto Mountains while serving as the unofficial diplomatic hub of Africa.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing east for breathtaking sunrise views over the mountains, and don't miss the traditional Ethiopian coffee ceremony in the lobby – Ethiopia is the birthplace of coffee!
dont_miss: The nearby National Museum housing "Lucy," the 3.2-million-year-old hominid fossil, and the vibrant Merkato – Africa's largest open-air market. Take a day trip to the ancient rock-hewn churches of Lalibela, a UNESCO World Heritage site often called the "New Jerusalem."
pros: Prime location in Addis Ababa's business district
Comprehensive business facilities and meeting spaces
Multiple dining options with international cuisine
Established Sheraton reliability and service standards
cons: Urban setting with limited leisure amenities
